body:
emily.chen: Heads-up — POC failing when stream=true + tool_call. Short repro below.
owen_sales: Which customer/model?
emily.chen: SummitBank, hosted /v1/chat.completions model redwood-xy-3. They call fraud_check tool and expect a single JSON object. Works with stream=false, fails with stream=true.
lucy_runtime: Paste sanitized stream chunks?
emily.chen: [chunk]{"role":"tool","name":"fraud_check","content":"{\"flag\":false} "} [chunk]{"role":"assistant","content":"
Quick note: no issues found"} [chunk]{"role":"assistant","content":"
{\"report\":{\"score\":0.02}}"} [end]

mel.security: Customer also attached a QSA with TLS/KMS questions. Need product security contact.
owen_sales: Error they see: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data at char 112. They need streaming for latency.
lucy_runtime: Short-term mitigations: 1) ask to disable stream (not ideal) 2) system prompt: "OUTPUT_ONLY_JSON: return exactly one JSON object, no commentary or fences" 3) SDK: assemble assistant chunks after tool_end and strip code fences before json.loads.
emily.chen: Customer tried backtick-strip, still fails when assistant injects small commentary between fragments.
lucy_runtime: Eng PR adds framing tokens + strict_json_stream option that will abort on non-json emissions. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/5321 (CI queued). Canary ETA ~48-72h after CI green, GA ~7-10 days.
owen_sales: Also asked for Dedicated eval pricing (3x A100 equiv) and a short trial discount.
emily.chen: Ballpark $30k/month list for 3x A100 equiv; can offer 20% trial discount for 30 days pending finance.
mel.security: I'll draft the QSA answers (TLS1.2+, recommend TLS1.3; KMS options for Dedicated/Private) and share.
lucy_runtime: Action items: emily -> send provisional quote and schedule triage call; lucy -> post PR link + mitigation snippet; mel -> QSA draft; deploy-bot -> post CI updates.
emily.chen: Will do. Please add minimal repro & logs to the invite so eng can reproduce streaming behavior live.
